channel.title: Today in Signal history · Signal & Cyber Corps Museum Society
channel.description: A story a day from the history of the U.S. Army Signal Corps and Cyber Corps, from the Signal & Cyber Corps Museum Society's virtual museum.

item.title: On this day in 1877: Telegraph at the Wreck of the Huron
item.description: Early on November 24, 1877, the steamer Huron ran aground off Nags Head, North Carolina. Sgt. S. W. Naylor, the Signal Corps observer at Kitty Hawk, eight miles away, hurried to the scene and set up a telegraph station on the shore. It sent more than 550 messages through December 11. Only 34 of the 132 men aboard survived. #SignalCorps #ArmyHistory
